info.name: Consents Account On File Account Controls (New) Account Controls (New) Open Banking Direct Debits API
Get Open Banking Account Direct Debits

params.name: AccountId
params.description: The Lean account identifier uniquely identifying the account within Lean.

params.name: EntityId
params.description: The entity_id of the connected customer.

params.name: CustomerId
params.description: The customer_id of the connected customer.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page you're requesting - returns page 0 of a response if not specified.

params.name: Size
params.description: The number of objects you want to return as a page size.

items.docs:
Retrieves the direct debits for a bank account linked by a user via LinkSDK for the KSA Open Banking (SAMA) ecosystem.
Each direct debit object contains the mandate identification, status, frequency, and previous payment details.
Requires ReadDirectDebits consent permission.
